errors.evidence: The prompt asks for the tick label interval if numeric and regularly spaced, but the description fails to mention that the x-axis ticks are labeled at an interval of 2 (i.e., 2, 4, 6, 8).
The prompt asks for the tick label interval if numeric and regularly spaced, but the description fails to mention that the y-axis ticks are labeled at an interval of 2 (i.e., 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30).
The description states the first line (light purple, circular markers) starts at a BLEU score of 22, but the plot shows it starts at approximately 20.2.
The description states the first line ends at (8, 28.4), but the plot shows its final data point is at approximately (7.8, 29.3).
The description states the second line (blue, square markers) ends at (8, 28.2), but the plot shows its final data point is at approximately (7.8, 29.3).

The description refers to a 'dark blue' line with square markers. There is only one blue line with square markers (already described as the 'second line') and a dark purple line with square markers. The description misidentifies the color of the dark purple line ('Inconsistency-CE').
The description claims the third line starts at a BLEU score of 24.7. However, the corresponding line in the plot (dark purple, square markers) starts at approximately 22.3.
The description states the third line ends at (8, 29.1), but the corresponding line in the plot (dark purple, square markers) has its final data point at approximately (7.8, 29.6).
The description states the fourth line ends at (8, 29.6), but the plot shows its final data point is at approximately (7.8, 30.2).
